items.description: Placeholder. Hours of hand woodcutting per log, at work speed 1.0 (a quarter of a real woodcutter's rate).
Placeholder. Hours of hand quarrying per stone, at work speed 1.0 (a quarter of a real quarry's rate).
Placeholder. Wheat from one hand-farmed harvest (a quarter of a real farm field's rate).
How far from the crown storehouse a hand gatherer's spot may be.
Placeholder. Stored food (loaves, later other real foods), counted as a month's supply per living person, when deciding whether food is short.
The most people who ever farm wheat at once, so a town never leaves its whole workforce waiting a month for the first harvest.

Placeholder. Below this many logs in the crown stockpile, the founders build a woodcutter's camp if a forest with stock exists (they also build one any time a waiting site is genuinely stalled for lack of logs, regardless of this reserve). Defaults to 0 - purely reactive to real demand - since logs start at zero every game; raise it to have the founders keep an ambient buffer on hand too.

Placeholder. Below this much stone in the crown stockpile, the founders build a quarry camp if an outcrop with stock exists (they also build one any time a waiting site is genuinely stalled for lack of stone, regardless of this reserve). Defaults to 0 - purely reactive to real demand.

Placeholder. Below this many planks in the crown stockpile, the founders build a saw pit if logs or standing trees exist (they also build one any time a waiting site is genuinely stalled for lack of planks, regardless of this reserve). Defaults to 0 - purely reactive to real demand.
How far the founders search for a free footprint when placing a starter building they decided to build themselves.
Whether the founders build a log cabin on their own the moment anyone is homeless. Founders and the monarch always have keep housing, so in practice this only matters once citizens exist (3.11+).

Whether the founders ever decide to build a starter building (a saw pit, a camp, a cabin...) on their own, without the player placing it. Off puts the crown's workforce entirely in the player's hands.
